title: Knowledge Reference Policy
description: Policy for Reference-level dependencies (citations and non-foundational pointers). Specification only.

rules.statement: Reference MUST use edge types REFERENCES or SUPPORTED_BY (or explicit level_id=reference).
Bibliography references MUST use existing SRC-* IDs; do not invent sources.
Reference MUST NOT be counted as Hard Dependency for release gates.
Orphan references to planned KR-* SHOULD note planned status.
Prefer SUPPORTED_BY when the reference underpins an assertion; prefer REFERENCES for see-also pointers.

non_goals: Reference is not Extension of canonical definition
Reference does not grant permission to skip academic review
